title: fix(react,vue): pass multiCursor prop through to createEditor
body:
## Summary

The `<Editor multiCursor>` prop was silently ignored in both React and Vue bindings — it never reached the editor engine.

## Motivation

- The OpenSpec `add-core-multi-cursor` (proposal.md:35) stated "React/Vue bindings need no code change" — correct when `UseEditorConfig = Omit<EditorConfig, "container">` meant all config flowed through automatically.
- When `onReady` and `value`/`modelValue` were added, both component wrappers switched to explicit destructuring of every prop. `multiCursor` was left out and fell into `...divProps`/`...attrs`, getting spread onto the container `<div>` as an invalid HTML attribute.
- Direct `useEditor({ multiCursor: true })` callers are unaffected.

## Changes

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `packages/react/src/editor.tsx` | +2 lines — destructure `multiCursor` and forward to `useEditor()` |
| `packages/vue/src/editor.ts` | +5 lines — add to `editorPropKeys` array and `props` definition |
| `packages/react/test/editor-react.test.tsx` | +64 lines — 2 tests |
| `packages/vue/test/editor-vue.test.ts` | +65 lines — 2 tests |

## Testing

- [x] `pnpm test` — **518 tests pass** (34 test files, 0 failures)
- [x] `tsc --noEmit` — zero errors
- [x] `tsup build` (react + vue) — both pass
- [x] 4 new vitest cases: prop forwarding, default-off, DOM leak guard (×2 frameworks)

## Compliance

- [x] CLA signed
- [x] No AI-generated functional code (manual diagnosis + fix)
- [x] No new dependencies
- [x] No build artifacts committed
- [x] React/Vue in lockstep (CONTRIBUTING.md §5)
- [x] No OpenSpec needed — bug fix restoring intended behavior

## Before / After

```tsx
// Before — prop silently ignored, leaked into DOM
<Editor multiCursor />
// Rendered: <div multicursor="true">  ← invalid HTML attribute

// After — prop reaches createEditor
<Editor multiCursor />
// Editor runs multiCursorExtension(), DOM is clean
```

commits_at_first_review.message:
fix(react,vue): pass multiCursor prop through to createEditor

The React <Editor> and Vue <Editor> components explicitly destructure
EditorConfig props before forwarding them to useEditor()/createEditor(),
but multiCursor was missing from both destructuring lists.

When a user passed <Editor multiCursor>, the prop fell into the
container-div attribute spread (...divProps / ...attrs) instead of
being forwarded to the editor engine. The core engine (editor.ts:497)
correctly wires it, and direct useEditor() callers are unaffected.

Add multiCursor to the React destructuring + useEditor() call, to the
Vue editorPropKeys array + props definition, and add four regression
tests (two per framework) verifying:
  - the prop enables multi-selection through the component boundary
  - omitting it defaults to single-selection
  - the prop does NOT leak into the DOM as an HTML attribute
